terra.problem: The claim about what Job's friends have been pressing him to admit draws on material outside this passage without a reference.
The claim that Job's friends keep accusing him draws on material outside this passage without a reference.
Calling Job stubborn states a judgment about his character as fact rather than marking it as Papa Dorin's impression.
Job is speaking in this passage; it does not say his friends are lecturing him right now.
Saying Job is making his friends think adds a response from them that the text does not give.
Calling the verse the opposite of a long life adds a detail about how long the sons live. Job says they are destined for the sword, but does not say when.
Saying the sons have no long life adds a detail about timing that Job does not give.
Nobody even stops to cry goes beyond the text, which says their widows will not weep for them.
No mourning at all goes beyond the text's statement that their widows will not weep for them.
The verse does not say the watchman's hut is set up for a short while.
By morning adds a time the verse does not give. It says all is gone when he opens his eyes.
